name: Child Labor
overview: Scripture reveals a compassionate view toward children, emphasizing their value in the kingdom of heaven as Jesus welcomes and blesses them despite opposition (Matthew 19:14; Luke 18:15). The Bible acknowledges the challenges and sorrows associated with childbirth but highlights the joy and hope a child brings (John 16:21). Believers are encouraged to find strength and courage in God’s sustaining presence (Isaiah 41:10; Philippians 4:13), which underscores the responsibility to care for and protect children rather than exploit them.
